input_contract.description: Retired token/state transition contract. Tokens formerly arrived from prontopc://run?token= or await-payment polling. The current StoreApp has no website token or server-side paid session.

output_contract.description: Historical authoritative session state, or a fail-closed refusal. Current plan/report evidence is local to the installed StoreApp.
output_contract.refusal: 402 unpaid (unknown/expired token) | 409 conflict (concurrent state change) | 400 (bad request)

observation_contract.description: Retired session spine. Diagnostics, plan, consent, repair, and report now run through local app state after Store acquisition. The findings relay remains session-keyed locally, but no Cloud Run paid-session token is required.

evidence_contract.description: Historical session state lived in Firestore (paidSessions), keyed by token. Current StoreApp source no longer writes this state.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: No current StoreApp behavior depends on this paid-session lifecycle. Live Firestore retention or deletion is a separate owner-approved gate.
